Author: Sadonia
Name: Velvet Dairy
Punchline: (Work in progress) A cozy 18+ dairy life: be the cow, run a dairy with friends, and bottle the finest milk in Eorzea.
Description:
WORK IN PROGRESS: Velvet Dairy is still being built and tested. Expect bugs, balance changes and missing pieces.

Velvet Dairy turns your house into a working dairy, and you're the cow.

- Keep your hunger, thirst, comfort and mood up with feed and treats
- Get milked in your dairy's stalls or by hand by a farmer, and watch your bottles fill
- Sell to the creamery, fill customer orders and raise your milk from Grade C to S+
- Level up for bigger bottles and better stalls, and empty them before the milk spoils
- Join the Velvet Dairy Network: register your estate, invite farmers, cows and bulls, browse public dairies, visit them and deliver milk for coins
- Dairies level up together: members earn dairy XP, pool coins in a shared fund for stalls, and compete on the weekly leaderboard

Coming in new updates: full Farmer and Bull roles. Farmers can already hand milk and invite cows and bulls, and bulls are a role only for now.

Adults only (18+); Lalafell characters can't play. It never posts to chat or moves your character. Lifestream is optional, for one-click travel to public dairies.
